cover.title: 5 Apps for a 90-Day Transformation
cover.subtitle: Plan it. Fuel it. Prove it.

apps.name: Fitbod
apps.description: Generates strength sessions from your history, available equipment, and recovered muscle groups.

apps.name: Cronometer
apps.description: A detailed food log for keeping protein, calories, and micronutrients visible through the full 90 days.
GainFrame turns repeat progress photos into a visual trend so the transformation has more proof than scale weight.

apps.name: Sleep Cycle
apps.description: A low-friction sleep tracker for catching the recovery habit that usually disappears first.

apps.name: Happy Scale
apps.description: Turns volatile daily weigh-ins into a calmer moving trend that is easier to judge over 90 days.

caption: day 1 motivation is cute. day 60 data is better.
